    Finite intervals in a graded category #

    The interval category has objects (X,r) for 0 ≤ r ≤ m and morphisms the degree r-s part of Hom(X,Y). When C is the category of projectives of the standard form, this is the finite category defining the manuscript's interval algebra. Here we construct the category and its Hom coordinates; the equivalence of its modules with supported graded modules is separate.
